title: 7-Day Future Self Connection
description: Your brain treats your future self like a stranger. This program helps you build a connection with who you're becoming.
outcomes: Connect with your future self as a real person
Make decisions that consider long-term consequences
Build empathy for who you'll be tomorrow

days.title: Letter to Future Self
days.insight: Writing to your future self creates a bridge between present and future. You're not separate people.
days.action: Write a letter to your future self. What do you want them to know? What advice do you have? What are you working toward?
days.reflectionQuestion: Who do you want to become?

days.title: The 10-Year Test
days.insight: Ask: will this matter in 10 years? Most of what feels urgent today won't.
days.action: When making a decision, ask: will this matter in 10 years? If not, simplify. If yes, prioritize.

days.title: Future Self Visualization
days.insight: Your brain needs to see your future self as real. Visualization makes it tangible.
days.action: Visualize your future self for 5 minutes. Imagine their home, their life, their days. What do they value? How do they act?
days.reflectionQuestion: What does my future self look like?

days.title: Small Wins for Future Self
days.insight: Future self is built through small, consistent actions today.
days.action: Do one thing today that future you will thank present you for. It can be tiny — a 5-minute walk, a saved dollar.
days.reflectionQuestion: What small action will future me appreciate?

days.title: The Empathy Shift
days.insight: Treat future self like you'd treat a friend you care about. Would you set them up for failure?
days.action: Before making a decision, ask: am I treating future self like a friend? Would I want this for someone I love?
days.reflectionQuestion: How would I treat a friend in this situation?

days.title: Values Alignment
days.insight: Future self is built on present choices that align with your values.
days.action: List your top 3 values. Look at your current tasks. Which align with these values? Which don't? Adjust accordingly.
days.reflectionQuestion: Do my actions align with my values?

days.title: Gratitude for Future Self
days.insight: Gratitude creates connection. Thank future self for all they'll become.
days.action: Write a gratitude letter to your future self. Thank them for the work they're doing, the growth they're doing, the person they're becoming.
days.reflectionQuestion: What am I grateful for about my future self?
